Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in its initial analysis and decision-making process. Although it correctly identified in its thought process that "folding of plates typically produces mountain ranges," it incorrectly interpreted the search results provided by the WebSurfer (which explicitly stated that fold mountains are created by compression/folding) as evidence supporting a volcano. The Planner hallucinated a causal link between "folding" and "volcanoes" (attributing it to subduction/magma generation) and ignored the direct definition of fold mountains found in the source text. This led to the selection of the wrong answer (Volcano) instead of the correct one (Mountain Range).
